schemas.//: ORDS collection feeds all share this envelope. Row shapes are declared per page in the page JSON 'types', which is the pattern this codebase already uses, so the rows stay loosely typed here.

error.description: The business rule's own message, ready to show in a toast.

actorEmpId.description: The acting manager's employee id. RULE-015 rejects self-approval.

onDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD; any day inside the wanted week.

cells.description: Every changed cell in the grid.

workDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD — the affected day. Adjustments are day-wise.

newHours.description: Hours to Adjust (+). 0 to cancel only.

employees.description: Omit for the whole project month.

accrualRows.description: Rows written to XX_O2C_TIMESHEET_ACCRUAL_IF for the accrual pull.

scopeKey.description: Country for CORPORATE, customer for CLIENT, projectId for PROJECT, employeeId for SHIFT.

status.description: Y = stored by accrual, E = rejected.
